main_protocol_assessment: Runnable in common production-native one-minute domain, conditional on freezing independent non-template generator, configurations and evaluation before test.
power_recovery_semantics: First post-task entry into band with dwell, not guaranteed final physical recovery before future delayed rebound.
known_simulator_baseline_limit: Process-reconstruction benchmark, not evidence that unknown counterfactual reference has been solved.

KIT_real_auxiliary.selection: Uniform original-time indices from admitted command edges, no response-error ranking; no replacement after preparation failure.
KIT_real_auxiliary.time_unit: seconds, using original relative integer microseconds
KIT_real_auxiliary.amplitude: Signed command-normalized observed phase-current change, not net power reduction
KIT_real_auxiliary.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of source observations in half-open bins; no interpolation/fill; preserve raw arrays.
KIT_real_auxiliary.optional_perturbation: Predeclared identical additive input perturbation for each method; feature stability only, not latent truth recovery.
